klipler.istem: A small bat flits quickly across the twilight sky above the balcony lamp, wings flapping naturally, steam rising gently from the tea cups. Slow camera. Storybook watercolor style preserved.
The bat swoops and flutters around the glowing street lamp chasing a moth, wings flapping naturally, moths fluttering in the light. Static camera. Storybook watercolor style preserved.

The bat flies forward with flapping wings as soft glowing sound-wave arcs pulse outward from its mouth toward the fluttering moth and faint echo arcs return. Smooth gentle motion. Storybook watercolor style preserved.
The mother bat hanging from the beam gently wraps her wing around the baby clinging to her chest; the baby moves slightly. Calm, tender, static camera. Storybook watercolor style preserved.

In the dark bedroom the bat flies calmly out through the wide open window into the starry night sky and disappears; curtains move slightly in the breeze. Static camera. Storybook watercolor style preserved.
Bats fly gracefully across the violet twilight sky over the village roofs, the crescent moon glowing, distant lights flickering on. Slow camera pull-back. Storybook watercolor style preserved.
